<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally and bond gains:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty surged over 500 points as softer US inflation data reduced global rate hike concerns, simultaneously driving Indian 10-year bond yields down to 6.76%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQS1BacDRBT1pMZGUtSFZXS3Mybzh2N09fREM3TUgxY2NmbDhHWWgwQWF2SHo4ZHpCdHo2anFzYVhXWFk2MjJOWDhrdE9iRW5tRkhkaFRvQWpXMmlISm14TmV3alZydXBxelUzY0Z2WjFaUnF4eHVsNFNObEdFN2RKRGZsRG8tdWtfUGdPdWFxUUxwa1RIS1FiZC1zVmZLTFJYdTVIN091T3NUYmZnR1UxZGt6X2wzNnIzVUV0aFVvOXdoZ2pnbHRF?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>

</ul>
